depth_justification: References GlucoCare's real facts (CE Class I, CH/DE, glucose/carb/insulin logging, the 1-page consent + separate health-data toggle) and cites GDPR/MDR/Swiss DSG, but it repeatedly ignores the looping user turn, dumps templated P5/P6 dimensions, misfires GDPR Art. 22 (automated decision-making) for accessibility, and never confronts the central insulin-logging clinical risk the persona downplays.
actionability_justification: Gives several concrete, buildable steps (granular consent toggles, a one-click 'Withdraw Consent' in settings, CSV/PDF data export, offline entry+sync, a 72-hour breach plan) and, when asked, produces the requested severity-grouped report with an uncovered-dimensions list, though some items stay directional.
salient_examples: Allow granular consent toggles for specific data uses (e.g., sharing with doctors, analytics, marketing)
